0: Incidence of juvenile-onset recurrent respiratory papillomatosis (JORRP)

cohort.0: The study monitored Australian children diagnosed with JORRP, identified through a national paediatric surveillance unit which enrolled pediatric otorhinolaryngologists.

finding.0: The incidence of JORRP in children declined significantly from 0.16 per 100,000 in 2012 to 0.02 per 100,000 in 2016 following the implementation of a national quadrivalent HPV vaccination program.

mod_finding.0: Among the 15 incident JORRP cases reported, 13 (87%) were born vaginally.
